title: Addicted to war
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why can war become economically or politically difficult for a country to stop?
Can a society become too accustomed to military solutions?
Who benefits when a conflict continues for many years?
How can ordinary citizens influence leaders who repeatedly choose confrontation?
What signs would show that a country is becoming 'addicted' to war rather than using force only as a last resort?
